title: 第7章  洛家主洛玄宸第8章  海城御兽师协会
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
洛玄宸吸烟的动作一顿，目光再次转向洛星燃。
“星燃，你刚才说什么？”
“s级天赋？”
“你把今天所发生的事情都原原本本地跟我讲一遍。”
闻言，洛星燃答应一声，便一五一十地将今天发生的事情向洛玄宸讲述了一遍。
而听完洛星燃的讲述，洛玄宸将手中的烟掐灭，轻轻呼出一口气。
“星燃，你先回房间换身衣服吧，可不要着凉了。”
洛玄宸说着，再次拿出一根香烟，将香烟点燃，吞云吐雾起来。
“嗷嗷～”
洛星燃从沙发上起身，径直往自己的房间走去。
等洛星燃离开后，偌大的客厅中只剩下洛玄宸一人。
洛玄宸吸了一口手中的烟，眼中出现淡淡的沉思。
s级的御兽师天赋，无论放在任何地方，都是会受到重视的存在。
也有极高的投资价值。
若是能投资成功的话，这将会是一个崛起的机会。
御兽界中曾经就有一个非常成功的案例，原本只是一个偏远小地方的陈家，不遗余力地投资了一位尚未成长起来的s级御兽师，结果等其成长起来后，那名s级天赋的御兽师成为位高权重的御兽师协会第七席，而本是小地方的陈家也成了现在的一流大家族。
而现在有一个s级天赋的御兽师消息摆在眼前，洛玄宸感觉未尝不可效仿一下当初的陈家。
但在此之前，需要先了解一下具体情况，再好好地观察一下，看看究竟是不是适合投资，又该如何投资。
香烟掐灭。
洛玄宸从口袋中拿出手机，拨通了一个号码。

很快，电话接通。
一个清冷的声音从手机的另一头传出：“什么事？”
“云会长，我想请你帮个忙，帮我调查一个人。”
洛玄宸的声音非常温和，给人一种如沐春风的感觉。
“你要查谁？”
云会长的声音继续响起。
“一个叫夜离殇的小姑娘，在沧澜高中上学，帮我查查她的背景情况就行。”
洛玄宸简单说了一下后，就静静等着对面的回复。
“等我消息。”
云会长说了一声后，就将电话挂断。
洛玄宸将手机放在一旁，自顾自地倒了一杯清茶，默默等待起来。
十几分钟后。
手机接连响起提示音。
洛玄宸将手机拿起，仔细观看起云会长所发来的信息。
信息的内容非常普通，就是夜离殇和她母亲夜梦璃的基本情况而已。
“没什么背景，只是家里有点小钱吗？”
洛玄宸默默翻看着。
但很快洛玄宸就发现有点不对劲的地方。
夜梦璃的信息只到十七年前，再往前则完全是空白，而夜离殇现在则是十七岁。
叮咚～
content_en:
Luo Xuanchen stopped smoking and turned his eyes to Luo Xingran again.
"Xingran, what did you just say?"
"S-level talent?"
"Tell me exactly what happened today."
After hearing this, Luo Xingran agreed and told Luo Xuanchen everything that happened today.
After listening to Luo Xingran's story, Luo Xuanchen put out the cigarette in his hand and breathed out gently.
"Xingran, please go back to your room and change clothes first. Don't catch a cold."
Luo Xuanchen said, took out a cigarette again, lit it, and started puffing away.
"Ouch~"
Luo Xingran got up from the sofa and walked straight to his room.
After Luo Xingran left, Luo Xuanchen was the only one left in the huge living room.
Luo Xuanchen took a sip from the cigarette in his hand, with a hint of contemplation in his eyes.
S-level beast master talents will be valued no matter where they are placed.
It also has extremely high investment value.
If the investment is successful, this will be an opportunity to rise.
There was once a very successful case in the world of beast masters. The Chen family, which was originally a small and remote place, spared no effort to invest in an S-level beast master who had not yet grown up. As a result, when he grew up, the S-level talented beast master became the seventh seat of the powerful Beast Master Association, and the Chen family, which was originally a small place, has become a first-class family.
But now that there is news about an S-level talented beastmaster before his eyes, Luo Xuanchen feels that he might as well imitate the Chen family.
But before that, you need to understand the specific situation first, and then take a closer look to see whether it is suitable for investment and how to invest.
Cigarette stubbed out.
Luo Xuanchen took out his mobile phone from his pocket and dialed a number.
Soon, the call was connected.
A cold voice came from the other end of the phone: "What's the matter?"
"President Yun, I would like to ask you to do a favor. Help me investigate a person."
Luo Xuanchen's voice was very gentle, giving people a feeling of spring breeze.
"Who are you looking for?"
President Yun’s voice continued to sound.
"There is a little girl named Ye Lishang who studies at Canglan High School. Just help me check her background."
After Luo Xuanchen said briefly, he quietly waited for the reply from the other party.
"Wait for my news."
After President Yun said this, he hung up the phone.
Luo Xuanchen put his phone aside, poured a cup of tea, and waited silently.
Ten minutes later.
The phone beeps one after another.
Luo Xuanchen picked up the phone and carefully read the message sent by President Qiyun.
The content of the message was very ordinary, just the basic situation of Ye Lishang and her mother Ye Mengli.
"No background, just a little money at home?"
Luo Xuanchen looked through it silently.
But Luo Xuanchen soon discovered that something was wrong.
Ye Mengli's information only goes back to seventeen years ago, and it is completely blank from that point forward. Ye Lishang is seventeen years old now.
Ding dong~
